metadata.description: OMR (Optical Music Recognition) for Claude Code — turn sheet-music photos/scans into editable MusicXML, splitting multi-piece pages first.

plugins.name: omr-notes
plugins.description: Recognise printed sheet-music photos/scans into editable MusicXML. Splits a page into one image per musical piece BEFORE OMR (so multiple songs on one page are not merged), then runs Audiveris and/or oemer.

plugins.name: notes-to-piano
plugins.description: Render a scanned music score into realistic piano audio (WAV/MP3). Consumes the MusicXML/MIDI from omr-notes and synthesizes it offline with FluidSynth + a CC-BY grand-piano soundfont. Optional dynamics humanization, tempo override, and score PDF.
